## Rankora Codebase - Team/Collaboration Features Exploration Report

Based on my thorough analysis of the codebase, here's what exists and what doesn't:

### WHAT EXISTS - Comprehensive Team Collaboration System

#### 1. **Database Tables (Created in Migrations)**

**Core Team Tables:**
- **teams** - Workspaces for collaborative hiring
  - Fields: id, name, owner_id, created_at, updated_at
  - Every user gets a personal team on signup
  
- **team_members** - Users belonging to a team with their role
  - Fields: id, team_id, user_id, role (owner/admin/member), joined_at
  - Unique constraint: (team_id, user_id)
  
- **team_invitations** - Email-based invitations to join teams
  - Fields: id, team_id, email, role, invited_by, status (pending/accepted/declined/expired), token, created_at, expires_at (7 days)
  - Unique constraint: (team_id, email)

**Collaboration Tables:**
- **candidate_notes** - Team-visible notes on candidates
  - Fields: id, resume_id, job_id, author_id, note_type (general/positive/concern/flag), content, created_at, updated_at
  - Visible to all team members of the job's team
  
- **tasks** - Team tasks linked to jobs/candidates
  - Fields: id, team_id, title, description, assigned_to, created_by, job_id, resume_id, status (todo/in_progress/done), priority (low/medium/high), due_date, completed_at, created_at, updated_at
  - Scoped to team level

**Supporting Relationship:**
- **jobs** table now has team_id column (optional, references teams)
- Auto-set to user's owner team on job creation

---

#### 2. **Role System**

Three tiers of roles via custom enum `team_role`:
- **owner** - Team creator, full control
- **admin** - Can manage members, send invites, update roles, manage tasks/notes
- **member** - Can view team data, create/edit own content, participate in tasks/notes

---

#### 3. **Components & Pages**

**Primary Pages:**
- `/team` - **Team.tsx** - Full team management UI
  - View team name
  - See all team members with roles, join dates
  - View pending invitations with expiry dates
  - Invite new teammates (email + role selector)
  - Revoke pending invitations
  - Change member roles (admin/member)
  - Remove members from team
  - Only accessible to owners/admins for management actions

- `/tasks` - **Tasks.tsx** - Team task management
  - Create tasks with title, description, priority, due date
  - Assign tasks to team members
  - Filter by status (todo/in_progress/done)
  - Mark tasks as done
  - Delete tasks
  - Real-time updates via Realtime subscription

**Sub-Components:**
- **CandidateNotesPanel.tsx** - Collaborative notes on candidates
  - Display notes from all team members
  - Color-coded note types (general, positive, concern, flag)
  - Author name and timestamp
  - Delete own notes
  - Real-time updates

**Sidebar Integration:**
- Team and Tasks links added to main navigation (in JobSidebar.tsx)
- Both visible to authenticated users

---

#### 4. **Hooks (Business Logic)**

- **useTeam()** - Fetches team data, members, invitations
  - Returns: team object, members array, invitations array, user's role, loading state
  - Prefers user's owned team, falls back to any team membership
  
- **useTasks()** - CRUD for team tasks
  - Real-time subscriptions to task changes
  - Create, update, delete tasks
  - Handles completed_at timestamp automation
  
- **useCandidateNotes()** - CRUD for candidate notes
  - Real-time subscriptions to note changes
  - Add notes with type classification
  - Delete notes
  - Filters by resume_id and job_id

---

#### 5. **Authentication & Invitation Flow**

**Edge Functions:**
- **send-team-invite** (`/supabase/functions/send-team-invite/index.ts`)
  - Auth required (team admin/owner only)
  - Validates email format, prevents self-invitations
  - Checks user isn't already a member
  - Upserts invitations (refreshes pending, re-invites after decline/expiry)
  - Sends HTML email via Resend with invite link
  - Returns invitation object with token
  
- **accept-team-invite** (`/supabase/functions/accept-team-invite/index.ts`)
  - Auth NOT required initially (supports signup flow)
  - Validates token expiry and status
  - Email matching for signed-in users
  - Creates team_members entry on acceptance
  - Updates invitation status to "accepted"
  - Returns team_name and role

**Auth Integration:**
- Special handling in Auth.tsx for `?invite=<token>` URL parameter
- Auto-accepts invitations for emails matching signed-in user
- Redirects to /team on successful acceptance
- Trigger `handle_new_user()` auto-accepts pending non-expired invitations matching new user's email

---

#### 6. **Row-Level Security (RLS) Policies**

**Team-specific policies:**
- Team members can view their teams
- Team owner can update team name
- Team members can see full roster
- Admins can add/update/remove members
- Members can leave themselves

**Invitation policies:**
- Only admins can manage invitations

**Candidate notes policies:**
- Team members can view notes on team's jobs
- Team members can add notes to team's jobs
- Authors can update/delete own notes
- Team admins can delete any note

**Task policies:**
- Team members can view all team tasks
- Team members can create tasks
- Creator, assignee, or admin can update
- Creator or admin can delete

**Cross-table policies (updated):**
- Jobs: User OR team member of job
- Resumes: Job owner OR team member of job
- Results: Job owner OR team member
- Candidate stages: Job owner OR team member
- Stage history: Job owner OR team member
- Applications: Job owner OR team member

---

#### 7. **Notifications & Realtime**

**Auto-generated notifications on team actions:**
- `task_assigned` - When task assigned to non-creator
- `task_completed` - Notifies creator when task marked done
- `stage_changed` - Broadcasts to all team members (except changer) when candidate stage changes
- `note_added` - Broadcasts to all team members (except author) when note added
- `member_joined` - Implicit support in notification types

**Database triggers** in migration 20260407200000:
- Functions automatically insert notifications on relevant events
- Realtime publication enabled for tasks and candidate_notes

---

#### 8. **Sidebar Navigation**

JobSidebar includes:
- **Main Section:** Tasks icon/link
- **Settings Section:** Team icon/link (under Billing, above Career Page, Settings)

---

#### 9. **User Provisioning**

**On new user signup:**
- Trigger `handle_new_user()` creates:
  - Personal team (named "[user_name]'s Team")
  - team_members entry with role="owner"
  - Auto-accepts any pending, non-expired invitations matching user's email
- Backfill migration: Creates teams for existing users

---

### WHAT DOESN'T EXIST

1. **No Workspace/Organization hierarchy** - Teams are flat; no team-of-teams or org structure

2. **No team branding/settings page** - Can't customize team name, logo, or team-level preferences (beyond member management)

3. **No permissions beyond role hierarchy** - No granular permissions (e.g., "can edit jobs", "can delete candidates", "can invite members")

4. **No group/team invitations** - Bulk invite not implemented; one email at a time

5. **No job sharing within team** - Jobs tied to user_id; if a user creates a job, team members see it via RLS, but no explicit "share this job" feature

6. **No file/document sharing** - No shared storage, file attachments, or document collaboration beyond candidate notes

7. **No meeting/communication tools** - No built-in chat, video calls, or direct messaging

8. **No audit logging for team actions** - Candidate notes/tasks have created_at/updated_at but no "who changed what and when" log for team operations

9. **No teams view in admin panel** - Admins can't see/manage all teams; no team analytics or control

10. **No time tracking/project management** - Tasks have due dates and status, but no time tracking, subtasks, or dependencies

11. **No access logs/activity feed** - No "Team Activity" page showing recent member joins, invites sent, tasks created, etc.

12. **No team billing/seat management** - Billing is per-user, not per-team; no "add 3 seats" feature

13. **No team templates** - Can't copy/template team settings or task workflows

14. **No guest/contractor accounts** - Invites require email signup; no temporary guest access

---

### Summary

**Rankora has a solid, modern team collaboration system** launched April 7, 2026 with:
- Multi-member teams with role-based access control
- Email-based invitations with expiry
- Collaborative candidate notes with type classification
- Team task management with assignment and status tracking
- Real-time updates on shared data
- Proper row-level security scoped to team membership
- Auto-notifications for team actions

**It's at MVP level** - covers core multi-user hiring workflows (shared job access, collaborative notes, task delegation) but lacks enterprise features like granular permissions, audit logs, team branding, and bulk operations.
